resources.string:
This app is the on-device half of IdentityShield Layer 4 (Android client security). You do not operate it from this screen. The IdentityShield backend on your computer drives it over adb.

How to use it

1. Use an emulator or a dedicated test device only. Never use a personal or customer phone.
2. On the host, build the APK: cd android-companion and run ./gradlew assembleDebug.
3. Connect the device with adb and check that adb devices lists it.
4. In IdentityShield, authorize the target app's package name with POST /scope. It must also be on the server allowlist (IDENTITYSHIELD_ALLOWED_TARGETS).
5. Run a Layer 4 module (POST /tests/run, or the dashboard). The backend installs this APK and runs:
 adb shell am instrument -w -e target_package <pkg> com.identityshield.companion/.IntegrityInstrumentation
6. Results come back to the backend over adb. Read them in the dashboard under Recent runs.

What it checks (read-only): the target app's signing certificate, its requested and granted permissions, device trust signals (root and emulator indicators of this device), local data-at-rest flags, and its network security config.

Privacy: this app has no INTERNET permission, holds no API key or token, and never contacts the IdentityShield API or any server. It only asks for QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES so it can inspect the target app on Android 11 and later.

Remote control is not implemented. Nothing can drive this app except the adb harness.

Full manual: docs/MANUAL.md in the KYC-AuditLab repository.
